prose: Juan Ayala of the Juan On Juan Podcast returns to InnerVerse to bring forward his research on the mysterious alchemical formation of the homunculus, the alleged process and technique of creating life through artificial means. How can this supremely secretive subject inform us about the origins of humanity, modern AI tech, the generative powers of nature, Jesus and the Brazen Serpent, and the immaculate conceptions of the savior at the onset of each world age?
